steps.detail: Leading/trailing spaces removed from all text fields.
claim_id starting TST- or patient_id starting TEST.
46 spelling variants collapsed to 8 payers. Dropped 27 rows whose payer was blank, N/A, UNKNOWN.
ISO, MM/DD/YYYY, DD-Mon-YYYY and YYYYMMDD parsed to one date type.
17 spellings mapped to Paid / Denied / Pending; 'Rejected' folded into Denied. 34 rows with a blank status dropped.
Currency symbols and thousands separators removed. 24 non-positive or non-numeric amounts set to null (kept for rate metrics, excluded from dollar totals).
CO16, co-16, 'CO 16', 16 and CO-016 unified to GROUP-NUMBER; 22 codes without a group assumed CO; 15 stale codes on paid claims cleared.
Upper-cased; ICD-10 codes missing the decimal had it restored.
70 exact duplicate rows dropped. 37 resubmitted claims collapsed to their latest submission.
